snippet.title: Sea of Stars | Mobile Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Sea of Stars is now available on iOS and Android!  ✨📱

One low price, no ads, and no microtransactions. 

We’re thrilled to have our little adventure meet new players everywhere! A huge thanks to Playdigious for this adaptation.

AppStore: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sea-of-stars/id6673906410

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.playdigious.seaofstars

Features:
- Revamped interface: exclusive mobile UI with full touch controls 
- Ultra-wide screen support
- Game Center &  Google Play Games achievements
- Cloud saves: share your progress between iOS or Android devices
- Controller support
